Orbit fitted to 161 live telemetry points from stardash.live (276 m RMS) and propagated with J2 gravity, no drag, up to the planned deorbit burn at 20:23:33 UTC. Burn, reentry at 20:58:22 and catch at 21:20:10 UTC (T+22:32:34) follow the published SpaceX timeline. The glide from the reentry point near Hawaii to Starbase is a sketch, not a simulation.
